caption: The drawing depicts a metallic teapot or pitcher with a cylindrical, slightly tapering body that widens toward the base, a rounded handle on the left, and a spout on the right. The central object appears silver or gray due to the pencil shading, with intricate highlights and shadows showing its metallic nature and curved surfaces. The pot has a lid with a rounded knob on top and a mechanical lever attached to the lid's hinge. On its front side, there is cursive handwriting that reads, "Warrie, from his Grandfather, Dec 25, 1856." In the upper right corner, an inset scale drawing provides the side profile and dimensions with a notation "SCALE: 1:3." In the lower left corner, another inset shows an enlarged detail of the handle's joint, emphasizing the ornamental and functional design of the attachment. The background is plain, and the drawing is rendered in shades of gray and black on a light-colored, possibly yellowed, paper. The artist's signature “C. Winter” appears on the lower right side of the main illustration.
title: Silver Tankard
